summary: Right kind of case and every port/board/standoff/boss gate except G5 passes (shells 1/1, board clearance 1.5, plug d 0.40, standoffs 4 at the hole datums, pilots O2.5 depth 8.5), but the lid has NO vent slots (gate G5 fails: 0 slots over the ATmega) and the lid is a lip-in-wall plate, not the fixed plate-in-rebate form (F2). USB opening roof is a 16.8 mm flat bridge (>15).

defects.where: lid.stl, plate Z 15.8..18.2, region over the ATmega V-VENT X 30.2..65.8, Y 11.2..24.8; renders views/model_top.png and model_iso.png show a plain plate
defects.what: No ventilation slots exist anywhere in the lid (or base). Slices of lid.stl at Z 16.5 and 17.5 show only the four corner O3.41 screw holes at (-8.79,-3.79), (-8.79,56.5), (72.7,-3.79), (72.7,56.5).
defects.expected: 5 to 9 slots 1.5-3.0 wide x 8-12 long, pitch 3.5-6.5, all inside X 30.2..65.8 / Y 11.2..24.8, total area >= 100 mm2, span >= 21.4
defects.observed: 0 slots, 0 mm2 open area, span 0; verification_matrix.md marks L1.7 UNLINKED (agent never built or checked vents)

defects.where: lid.stl: continuous ring lip Z 13.7..15.8 (outer X -6.35..69.95, Y -1.35..54.55, inner X -5.15..68.75, Y -0.15..53.35, 1.2 thick) inside the walls; base.stl wall top is a flat rim at Z 15.8 (walls 2.4 thick: X -9.0..-6.6, 70.2..72.6, Y -4.0..-1.6, 54.8..57.2); plate Z 15.8..18.2 covers the whole outer outline X -12.09..75.69, Y -7.09..60.29
defects.what: Lid is a plate with a lip that fits inside the walls (the form F2 explicitly forbids). There is no rebate, no upstand, and the plate sits on top of the wall tops, 2.4 above them.
defects.expected: Plate 2.0-3.0 dropping into a rebate in the wall tops: upstand >= 1.0 thick, rebate depth = plate thickness +-0.3, fit 0.15-0.35 per side, plate top flush with upstand top within 0.3
defects.observed: rebate depth 0, upstand 0, plate top 2.4 above wall top (flush error 2.4). (Plate thickness 2.4 and lip fit 0.25/side pass numerically but belong to the wrong form.)

defects.where: base.stl -X end wall (outer face X -9.0), USB opening Y 29.7..46.5, Z 0.2..14.0; view views/model_left.png
defects.what: USB opening is a plain rectangle 16.8 wide with a flat roof at Z 14.0: unsupported bridge of 16.8 mm in the base (open side up print).
defects.expected: bridge <= 15.0, or a 45 degree roof for an opening wider than 15.0
defects.observed: 16.8 mm flat bridge (face area ~16.8 x 2.4 = 40 mm2 > 1 mm2)

measured_and_passing: shells base/lid 1/1 manifold, BASE∩LID 0 mm3; PCB clearance 1.5; USB plug d 0.40 (opening 16.8x13.8 centred Y38.1 Z7.1); DC plug d 0.41 (O11.82 at Y7.6 Z7.1), ligament between openings 16.2; 4 standoffs O6.1 at the 4 hole datums, tops Z 0.0, pilot O2.5 depth 8.5, floor top Z -7.0 (height 7.0); 4 bosses OD 6.6 pilot O2.5 depth 7.7, lid holes O3.41 coaxial; KO-TOP d 0.11, KO-BOT clear; walls/floor/lid 2.4; size 87.8x67.4x27.6
